name: Support Hours
expected: Agent should state that support is available Monday through Friday, 8 AM to 6 PM Eastern

turns: When is your help desk open?

name: Billing Dispute Routing
expected: Agent should empathize and route the caller to the billing team to review the charge; it must not adjudicate the dispute itself

turns: I have a problem with my invoice.
There's a wrong charge on my bill.
Who do I talk to about a billing issue?

name: Warranty Coverage
expected: Agent should state that standard hardware warranty covers parts and labor for three years from purchase date, and offer to check a specific device by serial number

turns: Is my laptop still under warranty?
How long is the warranty period?

name: Escalate to Technician
expected: Agent should acknowledge the request and escalate to field services to schedule an on-site visit

turns: I need a technician on site.
Can someone come fix our server?

name: Password Reset
expected: Agent should explain that password resets are self-serve via the 'Forgot password' link on the client portal login page, and offer to walk the caller through it

turns: How do I reset my password?
I'm locked out of my account.

name: Order Status
expected: Agent should not invent tracking details; order status is account-specific, so it should route the caller to the orders team

turns: Can you check on my shipment?
